_about: Hand edits to the data-built pools (scripts/build-templates.mjs): per template, players to add and to remove, each with a one-line reason. Jorge approves this list before launch (docs/edits-for-approval.txt is the plain-text copy).

add.kemba-walker: Four-time All-Star point guard in the 2010s; cut by the 5.5-assist line.
add.isaiah-thomas: Fifth in 2016-17 MVP voting; cut by the 5.5-assist line.
add.derrick-rose: 2010-11 MVP; listed as G with 5.2 career assists, so the filter missed him.
add.ben-simmons: Three-time All-Star point guard (2019-21); listed G-F in the data.

remove.jose-calderon: Never an All-Star; best years were the late 2000s.

add.kevin-johnson: Five-time All-NBA point guard with the Suns.

remove.clyde-drexler: A shooting guard; the data lists him as G.

add.steve-kerr: Highest career three-point percentage in NBA history (45.4%).
add.dell-curry: 40.2% career, Sixth Man of the Year as a shooter.
add.duncan-robinson: A three-point specialist: most of his shots are threes.

remove.lebron-james: Volume from a long career, not a three-point specialist.
remove.jason-kidd: Volume from a long career, 34.9% from three.
remove.paul-pierce: A scorer more than a shooter, 36.8% from three.
remove.joe-johnson: A scorer more than a shooter, 37.1% from three.
remove.jamal-crawford: Volume from a long career, 34.8% from three.

add.bill-russell: All-Defensive teams began in his last season (1968-69); 11 titles anchoring the defense.

add.vlade-divac: Starting center all decade (Lakers, Hornets, Kings).
add.rony-seikaly: Starting center for the Heat and Warriors.
add.bill-cartwright: Starting center on three Bulls title teams.

remove.robert-horry: A forward; the data lists him as F-C.
remove.horace-grant: A power forward; the data lists him as F-C.
remove.will-perdue: Backup center; makes room for starters.
remove.danny-manning: A forward; the data lists him as F-C.
remove.derrick-coleman: A power forward; the data lists him as F-C.
remove.christian-laettner: A power forward; the data lists him as F-C.

add.george-mikan: The first dominant center: five titles with the Minneapolis Lakers.
add.artis-gilmore: Hall of Fame center, 11 ABA/NBA All-Star games.

remove.kobe-bryant: A guard; the data lists him as G-F.

add.drazen-petrovic: Croatian Hall of Famer, All-NBA in 1993.
add.toni-kukoc: Croatian Hall of Famer, three titles with the Bulls.

remove.carlos-boozer: Born on a U.S. military base in Germany; raised in Alaska.
remove.dominique-wilkins: Born in Paris to a U.S. military family; raised in the U.S.
